recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not add a Device maintenance person extension back into core; handle any future maintenanceResponsibility or lastMaintenanceTime edits in HL7/fhir-extensions, and use DeviceAssociation.relationship='maintainer' for R6+ core usage.
issue_request: FHIR-19848 asked to support CDA maintaining.Person in FHIR by adding a Device HL7 extension for a maintenance person; the final Applied/Persuasive with Modification decision explicitly made no core Device resource change and approved maintenanceResponsibility plus lastMaintenanceTime extensions.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR core commit for FHIR-19848 was found. The applied source appears in HL7/fhir-extensions commit 0737edd33c8c1665e7cb5e2eae08e54896850e24, which added device-maintenanceresponsibility and device-lastmaintenancetime for FHIR-19846, FHIR-19847, and FHIR-19848. Core retains only OID registrations for those extension URLs.
additional_context: Later FHIR-44336 changed the extension's individual slice from person/Reference(Person) to participant/Reference(Patient | RelatedPerson | Practitioner | PractitionerRole). OO 2025-07-07 minutes record that FHIR-19848 should be obsolete because of DeviceAssociation. FHIR-51494 added the build-scoped core DeviceAssociation maintainer relationship, and FHIR-51495 updated the Extension Pack extension to direct post-R5 users to that relationship.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source files were changed because the extension definitions are maintained in the FHIR Extension Pack and the current core replacement path already exists in DeviceAssociation terminology.
